d: A widow tries to find out why her daughter's strange behavior, a reaction to the death of her father, is progressively worsening.

Two school kids strike up a friendship with an orphaned puppy named Benji. When danger befalls them and they end up kidnapped by robbers who are in over their heads, Benji and his scruffy sidekick come to the rescue.
A heart-warming story of family and friendship starring Academy Award Nominee Toni Collette and Ioan Gruffudd.

t: The Adventurer: Curse of the Midas Box
d: Transporting you to a rambunctious realm of enchanting fantasy. When Mariah's little brother is kidnapped, he follows a trail of clues to discover a hidden realm of monsters, ancient secrets and a long-lost artefact. Feat: Michael Sheen & Sam Neill.

What happens when you find out your family dog is actually 600 years old and was once owned by a powerful wizard? This is what happens to Bobby and his faithful dog Ozzy when they stumble upon an ancient book of magical spells.

In this incredible true story, widowed father Leonhard travels 700 miles across treacherous ice with only his sled dogs for company, to deliver the anti-toxin to the hospital, after a deadly diphtheria outbreak hits the small Alaskan town of Nome in 1925.

An American inherits an old village church in England, where treasure is buried.  Greedy Mr. Slee scents his opportunity to snatch the treasure.  Diggity, a little cherub trying to earn his wings, helps uncover the treasure for the benefit of the village.

Ray’s been asked to chaperone a school trip with his daughter Sally’s class. When characters from Ray’s criminal past believe he stole the loot from a bank they robbed, Ray will do whatever it takes to keep his daughter and her class out of harms way.

When a former soldier finds himself homeless, he decides the best thing to do for his sick dog (Duke) is to leave him on the steps of a local animal shelter. The dedicated staff nurse Duke back to health and then launch a campaign to locate his owner...

An enchanting story of friendship and love! Wicked toy-maker Urfin wants to takeover Magic Land. But his evil plans are interrupted when Dorothy arrives, alongside a Scarecrow, a Tin Man, a Lion and doggy Toto.
